detail: Re-traced and measured by A16 (2026-10-11). Health is not early and fn-core is not slower: at C2's failing run (hbox:/tank/fn/scratch/integrate-20261011c/native-6d313a98f145/extract-run1/owner/core/owner-0.stderr) the core side's stalled barrier recovered at 14,750 ms (about 8.7 s of fdatasync after the stall file went) and the warm post's own barrier took 10,464 ms, with the device un-stalled, past the case's shortened 6,000 ms stall limit, so the post was answered 441 uncertain (correctly, by that limit). Rerun at the same binaries under strace (hbox:/tank/fn/scratch/vertical-core-barrier/t1): 6 iterations each side, recovery at 6,173-6,268 ms (core) and 6,205-6,332 ms (image); 600 fsync/fdatasync calls, the slowest 0.31 s. The time goes to the box's fdatasync under concurrent load on the shared pool; the code path is the same in both images (fnn-log-fence, fnn-log-fdatasync). The case runs its after-stall posts under the shortened limits it set for the stalled barrier; it now restores the defaults (5,000 / 30,000 ms) once health reports the recovery.
